concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-account-structure-resources-marketplace-structure]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace account/resource example for EU/US merchant and balance platforms, user and liable resources, and NL payment-to-payout flow; cross-region seller transfers require a single platform and exclude extra financial products.
warnings: The two-balance-platform EU/US example is not stated to have multiregional sellers transferring among themselves; do not apply it to the separate single-platform/financial-product-exclusion condition.
The schematic flow does not identify merchant of record, legal seller or funds owner for an actual payment, nor prove settlement or bank receipt.
